articles.title_en: Why do rational investors like variance at the peak of a crisis? A learning-based explanation
articles.title_cn: 为什么理性投资者在危机高峰期偏好方差？一个基于学习的解释
articles.abstract_en: Investors’ learning can drastically alter the dynamics of the variance risk premium: it no longer increases as economic conditions deteriorate but exhibits a highly nonlinear pattern, occasionally even turning negative. We demonstrate this intuition using a model where investors rationally form their belief about the hidden economic state. When the “bad” state becomes probable, investors start liking high future variance because it overwhelmingly correlates with lower marginal utility. This mechanism rationalizes the puzzling observation that risk-neutral volatility falls short of physical volatility at the peak of a severe crisis. Our results shed light on the interpretation of good economic uncertainty.
articles.abstract_cn: 投资者的学习可以极大地改变方差风险溢价的动态：它不再随着经济状况恶化而增加，而是呈现出高度非线性的模式，偶尔甚至转为负值。我们通过一个模型来展示这一直觉，在该模型中，投资者理性地形成对隐藏经济状态的信念。当“坏”状态变得可能时，投资者开始偏好高未来方差，因为它与较低的边际效用高度相关。这一机制合理化了在严重危机高峰期风险中性波动率低于物理波动率这一令人困惑的观察。我们的结果有助于解释良好经济不确定性的含义。

articles.title_en: Marginal tax rates and income in the long run: Evidence from a structural estimation
articles.title_cn: 边际税率与长期收入：来自结构估计的证据
articles.abstract_en: We estimate a life-cycle model of savings, labor productivity and entrepreneurs to measure the long-run response of income to marginal tax rate cuts in the US. Long-run tax elasticities of income are largest for the richest 1% but are also positive and substantial for other income groups. In equilibrium, entrepreneurs obtain higher returns on wealth. This increases the investment response of rich, high-return entrepreneurs, amplifying their income elasticity to tax cuts. This leads to a reallocation of capital which increases TFP, and generates a boost in wages that magnifies the estimated income response of the bottom 90% as well.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估计了一个包含储蓄、劳动生产率和企业家的生命周期模型，以衡量美国边际税率削减对收入的长期反应。收入的长期税收弹性对于最富有的1%人群最大，但对于其他收入群体也为正且显著。在均衡中，企业家获得更高的财富回报。这增加了富有且高回报企业家的投资反应，放大了他们对减税的收入弹性。这导致资本重新配置，提高了全要素生产率，并产生了工资提升，从而也放大了对底层90%人群估计的收入反应。

articles.title_en: More than words: Fed Chairs’ communication during congressional testimonies
articles.title_cn: 不只是言语：美联储主席在国会作证期间的沟通
articles.abstract_en: We study soft information contained in congressional testimonies by the Federal Reserve Chairs and analyze its effects on financial markets. Using machine learning, we construct high-frequency measures of Fed Chair’s and Congress members’ emotions expressed via their words, voice and face. Increases in the Chair’s text-, voice-, or face-emotion indices during the testimony generally raise the S&P500 index and lower the VIX. Stock prices are particularly sensitive to the Fed Chair’s answers to questions directly related to monetary policy. The effects during the testimony add up and propagate after the testimony, reaching magnitudes comparable to those after a policy rate cut. Our findings resonate with the view in psychology that communication is much more than words and underscore the need for a holistic approach to central bank communication.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究美联储主席国会证词中包含的软信息，并分析其对金融市场的影响。利用机器学习，我们构建了对美联储主席和国会议员通过言语、声音和表情表达的情绪的高频测量。主席在作证期间的文字、声音或面部情绪指数的增加通常会提高 S&P500 指数并降低 VIX。股价对美联储主席对与货币政策直接相关问题的回答特别敏感。证词期间的影响会在证词结束后叠加并传播，达到与政策降息后相当的程度。我们的研究结果与心理学的观点产生共鸣，即沟通不仅仅是言语，并强调了央行沟通采取整体方法的必要性。

articles.title_en: The chronology of Brexit and UK monetary policy
articles.title_cn: 英国脱欧的时间顺序与英国货币政策
articles.abstract_en: The outcome of the Brexit referendum in June 2016 was largely unanticipated. Even after the “Leave” vote, surprises regarding the withdrawal process affected the UK economy. We draw on an official list of political events published by the House of Commons Library and daily data on asset prices and economic policy uncertainty to construct a novel instrument for Brexit surprises. Including a monthly aggregate of this instrument into a vector-autoregressive model of the UK economy, an adverse Brexit surprise lowers GDP growth while raising CPI inflation. We provide evidence that the Bank of England fended off a worse economic contraction.
articles.abstract_cn: 2016年六月英国脱欧公投的结果在很大程度上是出乎意料的。即使在“脱欧”投票之后，有关退出进程的意外事件仍影响了英国经济。我们利用下议院图书馆发布的官方政治事件清单以及资产价格和经济政策不确定性的每日数据，构建了一个新颖的英国脱欧意外冲击工具。将这一工具的月度汇总纳入英国经济的向量自回归模型中，不利的脱欧意外冲击会降低GDP增长，同时推高CPI通胀。我们提供的证据表明，英国央行抵御了更严重的经济收缩。

articles.title_en: Haste makes waste? Quantity-based subsidies under heterogeneous innovations
articles.title_cn: 欲速则不达？异质性创新下的数量型补贴
articles.abstract_en: With quantity-based innovation targets and subsidy programs launched since the mid-2000s, China has seen a patent surge, accounting for 46% of the world’s total patent applications in 2020; however, the overall patent quality has been declining after 2008. This paper develops a Schumpeterian growth model featuring innovating firms’ quantity–quality trade-off between radical and incremental innovations, and decomposes subsidies’ aggregate impact into quantity and quality channels. We calibrate the model to Chinese firm-level data in the early 2010s. Our quantitative analysis shows that the quality channel effects are negative and dominant, and quantity-based subsidies in that period reduce the TFP growth rate and welfare by 0.19 percentage points and 3.31%, respectively. We evaluate welfare gains under a constrained planner’s problem, and propose skill subsidies which are quality-biased and effectively recover the optimal allocation.
articles.abstract_cn: 自2000年代中期以来，中国实施了基于数量的创新目标和补贴计划，导致专利激增，2020年占全球专利申请总量的46%；然而，2008年后整体专利质量持续下降。本文构建了一个熊彼特增长模型，刻画创新企业在激进式创新与渐进式创新之间的数量-质量权衡，并将补贴的总体影响分解为数量渠道和质量渠道。我们将模型校准至2010年代初的中国企业层面数据。定量分析表明，质量渠道效应为负且占主导地位，该时期数量型补贴使全要素生产率增长率和福利分别降低0.19个百分点和3.31%。我们评估了受约束计划者问题下的福利收益，并提出偏向质量的技能补贴，该补贴能有效恢复最优配置。

articles.abstract_en: We study the optimal monetary policy problem in a New Keynesian economy with a zero lower bound (ZLB) on the nominal interest rate, when the steady state natural rate (r∗) becomes permanently negative. We show that the optimal policy aims to approach gradually a new steady state with positive average inflation. Around that steady state, the optimal policy implies well defined (second-best) paths for inflation and output in response to shocks to the natural rate. Under plausible calibrations, the optimal policy implies that the nominal rate remains at its ZLB most of the time. Despite the latter feature, the central bank can implement the optimal outcome as a unique equilibrium by means of an appropriate nonlinear interest rate rule. In order to establish that result, we derive sufficient conditions for local determinacy in a general model with endogenous regime switches.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在名义利率存在零下限（ZLB）的新凯恩斯经济体中，当稳态自然利率（r∗）永久性为负时的最优货币政策问题。我们表明，最优政策旨在逐步趋近一个具有正平均通胀率的新稳态。在该稳态附近，最优政策意味着对自然利率冲击做出明确界定的（次优的）通胀和产出路径。在合理的校准下，最优政策意味着名义利率大部分时间保持在零下限。尽管有后一特征，中央银行可以通过适当的非线性利率规则将最优结果作为唯一均衡实施。为了确立该结果，我们在具有内生制度转换的一般模型中推导了局部确定性的充分条件。

articles.title_en: The emergence of procyclical fertility: The role of breadwinner women
articles.title_cn: 顺周期生育率的出现：女性养家者的作用
articles.abstract_en: Fertility in the US exhibits an increasingly more procyclical pattern. We argue that women’s breadwinner status is behind procyclical and lower fertility: (i) women’s relative income in the family has increased over time; and (ii) women are more likely to work in relatively stable and countercyclical industries whereas men tend to work in volatile and procyclical industries. This creates a countercyclical gender income gap as women become breadwinners in recessions, producing an insurance effect of women’s income. Our quantitative framework shows that rising breadwinner status of women can explain both the emergence of procyclical fertility and the decline in fertility rate in the second half of the 20th century.
articles.abstract_cn: 美国的生育率呈现出越来越强的顺周期模式。我们认为，女性的养家者地位是顺周期和较低生育率背后的原因：（i）女性在家庭中的相对收入随时间增加；（ii）女性更可能从事相对稳定和逆周期的行业，而男性则倾向于在波动性和顺周期性的行业工作。这造成了逆周期的性别收入差距，因为女性在经济衰退中成为养家者，产生了女性收入的保险效应。我们的定量框架表明，女性养家者地位的上升可以解释20世纪下半叶顺周期生育率的出现和生育率的下降。

articles.title_en: Credit constraints and firms’ decisions: Lessons from the COVID-19 outbreak
articles.title_cn: 信贷约束与企业决策：COVID-19疫情爆发的启示
articles.abstract_en: Using novel survey data on Italian firms’ expectations, collected just before and after the beginning of the COVID-19 outbreak, we investigate the role of credit constraints in the transmission of adverse economic shocks. Our results show that credit-constrained firms plan to charge higher prices than unconstrained ones while expecting a larger fall in quantities. When we consider realized outcomes, however, these differences are less pronounced. This evidence is consistent with the credit programs implemented during the crisis being largely unanticipated at its outbreak and benefiting constrained firms relatively more.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用在COVID-19疫情爆发前后收集的关于意大利企业预期的新调查数据，我们研究了信贷约束在不利经济冲击传导中的作用。我们的结果表明，信贷约束企业计划收取比无约束企业更高的价格，同时预期数量下降幅度更大。然而，当我们考虑实际结果时，这些差异不那么明显。这一证据与危机期间实施的信贷计划在很大程度上是疫情爆发时未预料到的，并且相对更多地惠及受约束企业的情况一致。
